L137: This wiki provides supplementary documentation about jq.
L138: 
L139: Note: jq version 1.8.0 introduced a potentially serious performance issue cite76†#3345 . The issue was addressed in the subsequent release, cite77†1.8.1 .
L140: If you want to learn to use jq, please head to the cite78†jq home page†jqlang.github.io . There you will find an overview, a tutorial, and a cite79†manual†jqlang.github.io . Here you will find supplementary documentation, notably the cite80†jq Language Description , which provides a more technical introduction to jq than the manual.
L141: 
L142: The documentation on this wiki is currently structured as the Sidebar menu (shown at the bottom in small screens) presents. Newcomers may find the following especially helpful:
L143:   * cite81†FAQ L144:   * cite82†Install jq L145:   * cite80†jq Language Description L146:   * cite83†jq Cookbook L147:   * cite84†Advanced Topics L148:   * cite85†jq Internals L149:   * cite86†Awesome jq - list of awesome jq tools and resources ↗
L150: 
L151: Users should also peruse the cite87†Pitfalls page.
L152: 
L153: As a rule, the documentation here follows the convention that:
L154: 
L155:   * official releases are referred to in the m.n format (e.g. 1.3, 1.4);
L156:   * a version number such as 1.4+ means a (sufficiently recent) version after 1.4.
L157: This wiki is currently open for editing by anyone with a GitHub login. Welcome!
